POST /v1/me/appeals: account appeal by a banned or frozen user inserts a processing appeal (prev_risk_state = the state) and sets risk_state appealing through the single-writer risk state service in the idempotency claim transaction, with a row lock on user_risk_state; a processing account appeal is returned on resubmit; order appeals, normal users -> 20001 (order appeals wait for B1-09). deadline_at = 3rd work day 24:00 +08:00 on the configured holiday / make-up workday calendar, weekend fallback with a private warn; never returned. GET /v1/me/appeals: own account and order appeals, newest first, cursor paging, no internal fields. Submission audit row deferred (audit_logs is admin-only; Jev 0.96, spec-sync follow-up).
